name: C/1996 N1 (Brewington)
note: Gravity reaches 18.75 sigma, falling to 2.58 sigma with free transverse water-ice recoil.

name: C/1996 J1-A (Evans-Drinkwater)
note: Independent 131-position pre-break parent sample gives 0.49 sigma. See orbits/fragment.

name: C/1996 E1 (NEAT)
note: Marsden and preperihelion gravity both give bound original orbits.

name: C/2002 O4 (Hoenig)
note: The full-arc Marsden fit is negative at 3.35 sigma. Published nongravitational fits to shorter data give a bound orbit following observed mass loss.

name: C/2002 T7 (LINEAR)
note: Marsden and preperihelion-only gravity both recover a bound original orbit.

name: C/2004 H6 (SWAN)
note: All 307 positions postdate perihelion. Adding normal recoil reduces the formal negative-energy significance from 3.61 to 2.69 sigma and shifts the nominal energy by more than an order of magnitude. Marsden reported marginally negative original energy in 2004.

name: C/1989 Q1 (Okazaki-Levy-Rudenko)
note: Marsden gives a bound original orbit; preperihelion-only gravity is marginal.

name: C/1991 Y1 (Zanotta-Brewington)
note: Full-arc Marsden gives 3.72 sigma, while preperihelion-only gravity is nominally bound and consistent with parabolic.

name: C/1975 V2 (Bradfield)
note: Both radial inverse-square and Marsden return bound original orbits.

name: C/1886 J1 (Brooks)
note: Brady reported an original hyperbola in 1965. Doubling the historical astrometric floor gives 1.36 sigma. One radial model misses 250 au.

name: C/1904 H1 (Brooks)
note: Signed radial inverse-square gives 0.60 sigma, and the 10 arcsec historical floor gives 1.67 sigma.

name: C/1917 H1 (Schaumasse)
note: Signed radial model is nominally bound; outward Marsden misses 250 au. A published broader re-reduction gives bound original energy.

name: C/1956 R1 (Arend-Roland)
note: Outward Marsden gives only 0.12 sigma on the nominally unbound side.

name: C/2009 R1 (McNaught)
note: Marsden returns positive original inverse semimajor axis.

name: C/2011 J2-B (LINEAR)
note: The positions are postperihelion measurements of the named B fragment. Two-parameter Marsden covariance is singular.

name: C/2021 O3 (PANSTARRS)
note: Full-arc Marsden gives 4.97 sigma, but preperihelion-only gravity is bound at 7.19 sigma.

name: C/2023 A3 (Tsuchinshan-ATLAS)
note: Marsden and inbound-only gravity both give bound original orbits.

name: C/2024 E1 (Wierzchos)
note: Marsden and preperihelion-only gravity both recover a bound original orbit.
